Cluster Contexts:
- Laezel_Recruitment_InCage.json: You're in the Druid Grove just after the den attack: celebrations are underway, Halsin has returned, and a distant blast/ship crash has already drawn attention. A pair of tieflings (who intended to bind and haul her off) have Lae'zel caged — they expected an easy prisoner but misjudged how dangerous and defiant she is. Lae'zel communicates coldly (often telepathically), insults bystanders, and demands release — warning you'll become "ghaik" if you don't free her. The player must free or neutralize her to recruit Lae'zel, and nearby companions (for example Shadowheart) may react or warn you against trusting the githyanki.

Lae'zel communicates telepathically, ordering the party to "get rid" of nearby NPCs, which explains her silent, lip‑still lines. The player can respond by ordering the tieflings to leave, attempting to free or neutralize the prisoner (shoot the trap), or otherwise intervene; if Shadowheart is present she will warn the player not to trust Lae'zel based on prior secret missions against githyanki.

context: You're in the Druid Grove just after the den attack: celebrations are underway, Halsin has returned, and a distant blast/ship crash has already drawn attention. Two tieflings had caged a defiant githyanki, Lae'zel; those tieflings have been dealt with one way or another off‑screen, but Lae'zel remains locked up and must be freed before she can be recruited. She communicates coldly and often telepathically (lips still), insults bystanders, and issues threats — for example warning you'll become "ghaik" if you don't free her. Nearby companions (e.g., Shadowheart) may warn you not to trust her, and the player has conversational and direct-action options (mockery, ordering the tieflings away, shooting the trap, or physically releasing her).
